references.text: Similar to the idea that many are called but few are chosen, as reflected in Jesus' parable of the workers in the vineyard.
Paul speaks about God having saved us and called us with a holy calling, not because of our works, but according to His own purpose and grace. This points to the idea of election.
Peter describes believers as a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's own people, which points to the idea that among the many called, some are chosen.
